Ten comments

Dezi Donnelly

This is the second tune in the set on track 5 of Dezi Donnelly’s album, “Familiar Footsteps”. I just posted the other yesterday. They are both listed as Gan Ainm so if we can come up with a name we can pass this on to Dezi through someone on the list who plays with Dezi’s cousin, Vinny.

↳ Posted by Donough on May 14th, 2004.

The Magpie’s Nest

Transcribed from a recording of last night’s session. I’m told the source was O‘Neill’s, but the musos here have put their own spin on it. Apparently the tune was a favourite of Paddy O’Brien’s.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on June 5th, 2006.
